QuestInfo.name: Entering Sakura Castle
QuestInfo.1: You convince Sasuke that Akai really sent you to find Nobuo, so he agrees to let you enter the castle...provided you deliver some throwing knives to his son, an aspiring ninja.\n
QuestInfo.2: You convince Sasuke that Akai really sent you to find Nobuo, so he agrees to let you enter the castle...provided you deliver some throwing knives to his son, an aspiring ninja. You find his son, Sai, inside the castle and deliver the knives.\n

0.0: Turn around NOW. I cannot let you enter. \r\n#L0##bBut Akai has an important message for Princess Suzume. She told me to find Nobuo.#l\n#k
0.1: A likely story. While Lady Akai and Princess Suzume ARE close friends, how do I know Lady Akai really sent you? \r\n#L0##bYou have a point. She could've given me an amulet or a flower or something as proof, but she didn't. Come on, I REALLY have to talk to Nobuo.#l\n#k
0.2: You've mentioned Nobuo twice now. Not many people know about him. Very well, I will trust you. You may enter, but... You must do me a favor as well.

yes.0: The castle is full of ninja. My son has always dreamt of being a ninja, so he snuck into the castle...and I haven't seen him since. I support him for pursuing his dreams, and I praise his ambition, but I want you to give him something for me.
yes.1: Take these Steely Throwing-Knives to #e#bSai#k#n. I have a hunch they will be of great service. There's not much else I can do for him right now...

no.0: Then I will not permit you to enter! Turn around!

1.0: Whooosh! I am ninja! You can no longer see me! I have disappeared into the shadows. \r\n#L0##bHi, Sai. Your father wanted me to give these to you.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh! Daddy sent you? Hey, these throwing knives are great! Perfect, because I just broke all the ones I had carving pictures into the wall!

yes.0: But seriously, you better get out of here as soon as you can. These ninja are serious business. Like, seriously. I can handle it, with my amazing ninja skills, but you don't stand a chance.

npc.0: Take these Steely Throwing-Knives to #e#bSai#k#n. I have a hunch they will be of great service. There's not much else I can do for him right now...

item.0: You do not see me. I am not here. Whoosh! If only I had some new throwing knives... I think I have something stuck under my nail.
